Included accessories comprise thirty-one pine cones and thirty-one red berry clusters, which are securely attached to the branches for added realism. The three-section trunk design enables simple separation, facilitating efficient packing into a compact box while maintaining the integrity of the branches and decorative elements for future use.

The flame-retardant properties of the branch tips ensure safe enjoyment for families gathering around the tree during the winter season. This safety feature allows users to bask in the warm, inviting holiday glow without concerns, making it a practical and secure choice for indoor displays in homes and offices alike.

5059442168828.sourceDescription:
The original Christmas tree, the Norway Spruce has been grown in the UK since Victorian times and is the variety most people picture at Christmas. Its classic conical shape, dark green foliage and fresh scent bring a traditional, nostalgic feel to your home, and its firm, slightly prickly needles are ideal for hanging decorations. Norway Spruce can drop needles if it dries out, so keeping it well watered is key. Our trees are grown in the UK and freshly cut before dispatch. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.
REAL FRESH CUT TREE - Add a traditional feel to your home this Christmas with a freshly cut, real Norway Spruce
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
TRADITIONAL LOOK AND FEEL - The classic Christmas tree look, with dark green foliage and firm, slightly prickly needles that are ideal for hanging decorations
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Handmade Detail
Handmade detailing contributes to the character of the design. The decorative elements give the product a distinct appearance that can be coordinated with the surrounding arrangement.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details
Material: Metal. Stated size: 6 mm. Quantity: 300 pack.
Handmade detailing adds character and a distinct appearance to your festive display.
Compact format allows the decoration to fit into smaller working or storage areas easily.
Metal construction provides durability for repeated seasonal use and decorative impact.
Pack of 300 pieces offers ample quantity to coordinate colour and texture across arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Resistant to shattering

5056463974728.sourceDescription:
Create an elegant festive focal point with this 69cm Christmas Candle Holder Centrepiece featuring three black metal candle plates and coordinated gold decorations. The arrangement combines layered artificial pine, cedar and cypress-style greenery with metallic and glitter-effect gold baubles, decorative berry sprays and pinecones for a traditional Christmas appearance. A large champagne-coloured ribbon bow decorated with white and gold snowflake details adds a distinctive finishing touch. Three integrated metal candle plates, each approximately 8cm across, provide dedicated positions for your own suitable candles, allowing you to personalise the display according to your preferred festive styling. Measuring approximately 69 x 28 x 19cm, the generous arrangement is suitable for dining tables, mantelpieces, console tables and window displays. Candles are not included. For safer decorative use, flameless LED candles are recommended. If using real candles, ensure flames and heat remain clear of the artificial foliage, ribbons and ornaments, and never leave burning candles unattended. A decorative Christmas centrepiece combining gold seasonal accents, textured greenery and practical candle display platforms.
GOLD FESTIVE DECORATIVE DETAILS: Metallic and glitter-effect gold baubles combine with decorative berry sprays and pinecones, creating an elegant coordinated Christmas arrangement with warm seasonal colours and attractive ornamental textures.
THREE BLACK METAL CANDLE PLATES: Features three integrated candle platforms measuring approximately 8cm each, providing dedicated positions for suitable candles to complete your festive dining table, mantelpiece or console display.
CHAMPAGNE SNOWFLAKE RIBBON BOW: Large champagne-coloured decorative bow features white and gold snowflake detailing, creating an attractive focal point that complements the metallic ornaments and traditional Christmas greenery.
FULL LAYERED ARTIFICIAL FOLIAGE: Pine, cedar and cypress-style branches combine to create a textured green arrangement, providing a natural-looking festive backdrop for the gold decorations, pinecones and decorative ribbon.
GENEROUS 69 X 28 X 19CM SIZE: Measuring approximately 69cm long x 28cm wide x 19cm high, the centrepiece creates a noticeable Christmas feature for dining tables, consoles, mantelpieces and suitable window displays. Candles are not included.

When the celebrations are over, they can be stored away in the supplied box ready for next year. With a practical, reusable design and a versatile festive look, these Christmas baubles are ideal for creating an attractive display year after year. They combine easy hanging, decorative finishes and durable construction to help you style your home with confidence and convenience.

5031470302528.sourceDescription:
Bring a winter-woodland feel to your front door with this Frosted Berry & Pinecone Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath. Available in 45cm and 60cm sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical festive glow to doors, walls, and other areas of your home.

COLOUR SWITCH & LED LIGHT EFFECTS: Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting.

FROSTED WITH CONES & BERRIES: Crafted with frosted dual-toned PVC needles, the wreath captures the look of winter woodland foliage for a cosy festive feel. Decorative pinecones and artificial berries create a rich natural finish, while soft tapered tips add texture and depth.

BATTERY POWERED WITH TIMER: Powered by an IP44-rated battery pack, the wreath can be displayed indoors or outdoors without worrying about plugging it in. A built-in timer conveniently switches the LEDs on at the same time every evening, then turns them off six hours later.

METAL FRAME FOR EASY HANGING: A durable circular metal frame makes the wreath easy to hang on front doors, walls, windows, or above your mantelpiece. Coloured dark green, it blends discreetly with the frosted foliage to create a neater, more attractive display when hanging.

Available Sizes: 45cm / 60cm
LED Count: 40 (45cm) / 50 (60cm)

Timer Function: 6 hours on / 18 hours off

Warm white & multi-colour LEDs with built-in colour switch
IP44-rated battery pack with timer for easy festive lighting
105 / 140 tapered PVC tips for a full natural look

5313817006628.sourceDescription:
Product Overview

 This festive pink Christmas tinsel garland comes pre-assembled with warm white clear wire LED lights and cute Santa & snowflake cutout decorations. 
 Powered by 3 AA batteries (batteries NOT included), it has two size options and supports steady-on & flashing lighting modes.

Specifications
Option 1: 3 m / 9.8 ft 30 Warm white LEDs 3AA battery box Steady on + FlashOption 2: 5.7 m / 18.7 ft 40 Warm white LEDs 3AA battery box Steady on + Flash

 Material: Soft pink PET tinsel, transparent wire with warm white LED, paper Santa & snowflake pendants
 Light color: Warm white (3000K)
 Power source: 3 × AA batteries (batteries excluded)
 Modes: Constant steady light & flashing twinkle, switch controlled by battery box
 Protection grade: IP44 (splash-proof, for indoor & covered outdoor use)
 Lifespan: 20000 hours

Application Scenarios
Christmas home decor, Xmas tree, front door arch, staircase railing, fireplace mantel, window frame, bedroom headboard, holiday party decoration, covered patio.
Notes

 Batteries are not included, please prepare 3 AA batteries before use.
 IP44 splash-proof: resistant to splashing water, do NOT submerge in water.
 Remove batteries when not in use for a long time to avoid battery leakage damage.
【Pink Christmas-Themed Design】Unlike traditional red and green Christmas lights, this string of lights features a fresh pink color scheme, paired with classic Santa Claus figures and whimsical snowflake accents for a soft and sweet style. Perfect as festive decor for your daughter’s bedroom, drape it over the windowsill or bed rail—the adorable color scheme will be a big hit with little ones, creating a sweet little Christmas nook.
【Total Length: 18.7 Feet & 40 LED Bulbs】This pink string light measures 18.7 feet in total length and features 40 evenly spaced LED bulbs, creating a perfectly balanced distribution of light. Whether draped around a Christmas tree, doorframe, or railing, a single strand of these pink lights can complete the decoration for a small area. There’s no need to connect multiple strands, resulting in a neater, more aesthetically pleasing look. The staggered lighting creates a more immersive Christmas atmosphere.
【2 Lighting Modes】This Christmas string light features two practical lighting modes—steady and flashing—with simple, intuitive operation. For a family Christmas Eve dinner or post-meal relaxation, turn on the steady, soft glow to create a quiet and soothing atmosphere; when friends and family gather or for a children’s Christmas party, switch to the flashing dynamic light effect to highlight the lively and joyful festive spirit. One string of lights meets a variety of mood needs.
【Battery-Powered】This pink garland is battery-powered, eliminating the need for electrical outlets or the hassle of long extension cords. Installation requires no special tools—simply wrap it around branches, door frames, railings, or window frames to secure it. Even beginners can set it up in just a few minutes. Taking it down and storing it after the holidays is just as easy; it folds flat to save space and can be reused next Christmas.
【Christmas-Themed Lighting】This Christmas tinsel garland is designed specifically for the holiday season. It can be wrapped around Christmas trees, front door frames, window frames, balcony railings, and stair handrails. It’s also perfect as a backdrop for Christmas parties, bedroom decor, and festive window displays—making it an excellent choice for creating that special Christmas atmosphere.
Guarantee - 1 month

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display

Lid Included

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.
